summary: Live Workout redesign (frontend/app/workout.tsx + workout-live.tsx) tested end-to-end at landscape tablet viewport 1280x800 after logging in as greenlantern@roujaune.app. Screen renders with NO crash / NO red-box; every requested testID is present. Header (live-menu, live-pill, live-audio, live-settings), route/workout title, ELAPSED counter (verified counting up: 00:00:05 -> 00:00:51 -> 00:01:02), progress bar and EST. FINISH all render. 4 metric cards (metric-power/heart-rate/cadence/interval) render; Interval card shows STEP 1/13, 7:07/7:00 remaining, 'Warm-up' label. Tapping live-pill flips DEMO->LIVE and metric cards immediately switch from em-dashes to live numbers (Power 183 W ON TARGET, HR 126 bpm ZONE 2, Cadence 87 rpm LOW) while ConnectionsPanel flips Trainer/Wearable to Connected and Power/HR/Cadence to Active (green) with 'All ride data active' footer. Alberto coach-banner renders a live AI cue about power. TerrainCard shows 7.2% grade / 1440 m elev / 19.9 km dist left with elevation profile; RouteMapCard shows 'Alpe d'Huez' + 0.1/20.0 km. IntervalTimeline shows 'Threshold Climb', STEP 1/13, X:XX REMAINING and NEXT UP 'Tempo Block 9:22 / 230 W'. Bottom control bar: bc-erg-down/up step ERG (100% -> 95% -> 100%), bc-pause toggles 'Pause' -> 'Resume' -> 'Pause', bc-audio opens Music panel (Alberto/Adriana coach selector, Cycling music, Volume, Voice), bc-mirror opens 'Mirror to TV' Cast panel with Chromecast steps, bc-controls opens controls-overlay, bc-end opens end-ride-prompt with end-save/end-abandon/end-resume and end-resume dismisses. live-menu opens menu-overlay with all 7 items (reconnect, music, settings, lock, peaceful, sensors, save). live-settings opens the Settings panel (FTP/Trainer/Wearable/Demo). inline-routes opens route picker; switch-virtual toggles into VirtualRoute view and switch-video toggles back. Zero React console errors captured during the flow. Central YouTube 'Video unavailable' in headless preview is EXPECTED per E1 note.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (iter 32) console deprecation warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' still emitted from src/theme.shadow helpers used across the workout screen (styles.toast + workout-live card shadows). Not new to this redesign but still worth migrating. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card / shadow.glow).

action_items: (Optional) Migrate theme shadow.* helpers to boxShadow to silence the RN Web deprecation warning; no functional impact.

(Optional polish) ERG value briefly snaps back toward 100% on rapid toggles because the visible number is telemetry.erg (echoed from the trainer sim) rather than a local optimistic value. Considering an optimistic local state so the % never appears to 'bounce' while the trainer catches up.

(Optional QA) Add data-testid selectors on the login inputs/submit (login-email/login-password/login-submit) to make future auth-flow scripting deterministic (currently we key off placeholder='Email'/'Password' and the visible 'Sign in' text).
critical_code_review_comments: workout.tsx cleanly rewires the redesigned body via new components imported from workout-live.tsx; no dangling references to the removed legacy body. Old workout components used elsewhere (VideoPlaceholder / RoutesButton / RoutePicker / SettingsPanel / MusicPanel / CastPanel / ImmersiveHud / RouteMapCard) are still imported from '@/src/components/workout' and mount correctly.

The demoMode toggle (live-pill) correctly threads through settings.demoMode -> trainerOn/wearableOn -> ConnectionsPanel + MetricCard placeholders in one place, so 'Demo ON' turns all rows green and shows live numbers atomically (verified visually).
Elapsed counter is driven by useTelemetry() and increments in real time whether or not a trainer is connected (verified counting up while DEMO was off and on).
workout.tsx is 768 lines (over the 700-line guideline). Consider extracting the CONTROLS/MENU overlays, end-ride prompt and cue-generation effects into small modules to keep the screen file lean.
All interactive elements expose testID and use RN Pressable/View/Text (no HTML divs); StyleSheet.create used throughout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses input[placeholder='Email' | 'Password'] + get_by_text('Sign in') until login-email/login-password/login-submit testIDs are added. Web auth token is in localStorage under 'roujaune_token'. The route video will always render 'Video unavailable' in headless Chromium (YouTube blocks embed) — this is expected. To force DEMO on from the URL you can also flip settings.demoMode via the live-pill (bottom of header). Landscape tablet at >=1024px width unlocks the 3-column tablet layout; on <620px height the compact layout kicks in with narrower left/right cols.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Redesigned Live Workout screen matches the reference layout (header + 4 metric row + 3-column body + interval timeline + control bar), all telemetry/BLE/audio hooks remain wired, and every requested interaction works.
